name: Product design debate
description: PM, Engineer and Architect debate a feature over the bus and produce a reviewed spec; only blocking business questions reach the user.
whenToUse: A new feature or product change needs a spec: scope, requirements, design and decisions.

texts.definition-of-done: The spec is done when: the user problem and success criteria are explicit; goals and non-goals are listed; every requirement is testable; each key decision has its rationale and the rejected alternative; risks have mitigations; open questions have an owner.

phases.title: Explore
phases.goal: Each role analyses the brief from its perspective and states a position: proposals, concerns and questions.
instructions: Read the codebase areas the brief touches before forming your position.

phases.title: Debate
phases.goal: Challenge and refine the positions until the team agrees on scope, approach and architecture.

phases.title: Decide
phases.goal: Ask the user only the questions that block the team and that only the user can answer.

phases.title: Spec
phases.goal: Write the agreed spec and get it approved by the other roles.

triggers: A scope or priority trade-off that changes what users get
A cost, licensing or infrastructure commitment
Business context the team cannot see
